title: Week 30 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “money”?
options: An asset widely accepted as a medium of exchange, unit of account, and store of value.
A representative government limited by a constitution and accountable to the people and law.
The principle that political authority originates with the people.
Responsiveness of quantity demanded to a change in price.
questions.explanation: Money means an asset widely accepted as a medium of exchange, unit of account, and store of value.
choices: An asset widely accepted as a medium of exchange, unit of account, and store of value.
A representative government limited by a constitution and accountable to the people and law.
The principle that political authority originates with the people.
Responsiveness of quantity demanded to a change in price.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “liquidity”?

The constitutional formula counting three-fifths of enslaved persons for representation and direct taxation.
Direct communication with public officials intended to influence decisions.

Authority granted to local governments to manage local affairs.

questions.question: Which action best demonstrates mastery of the Week 30 inquiry?
options: A student selects an answer only because it sounds confident, even when the record is incomplete or contradictory.
A student accepts the first available claim or offer without checking the source, terms, evidence, or consequences.
A student distinguishes liquidity from solvency and identifies the specific risk a financial safeguard is designed to address.
A student relies on political identity, advertising, or personal preference as a substitute for documented analysis.
questions.explanation: A student distinguishes liquidity from solvency and identifies the specific risk a financial safeguard is designed to address.
